name: io.github.kotiniiqq/migrate-to-n8n
title: Migrate to n8n
description: Convert Make and Zapier automations into n8n workflows, with a report of what to check.

environmentVariables.name: MIGRATE_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for converted workflows and reports (default: Documents/migrate-to-n8n)

environmentVariables.name: N8N_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your n8n address, to upload results (optional)

environmentVariables.name: N8N_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: n8n API key, to upload results (optional)
